name: Ostarine mini-cycle

lead: An ostarine mini-cycle is a short, time-limited period of using ostarine (enobosarm, MK-2866), an investigational oral selective androgen receptor modulator, with the goal of recomposition: slightly more lean mass and less fat for a more muscular, leaner look.

In trials, enobosarm raised lean body mass modestly in older adults and cancer patients. Forum users describe it as a milder option than steroids, which is how it gets framed for aesthetics-focused use.

paras: Users describe taking it orally for a limited number of weeks alongside training and diet, sometimes followed by a post-course recovery routine. Product contents and labeled amounts from online sellers are often inaccurate.

The FDA warns SARMs can cause serious harm including heart attack, stroke and liver damage. Trials showed dose-related drops in testosterone and HDL cholesterol and liver enzyme elevations. Many products sold online contain none of the drug or other substances, and SARMs are banned by WADA.

chain: Modest lean-mass gain and fat change
angle.text: Enobosarm increased lean mass in trials, and users run short courses hoping for a leaner, fuller physique. Effects seen in trials were small compared with testosterone.

lead: An ostarine mini-cycle is a short course of enobosarm (ostarine, MK-2866), an investigational selective androgen receptor modulator, used in bodybuilding and aesthetics circles for recomposition.[1]

Users on T Nation describe aesthetic goals: one poster said ostarine gave results close to a stronger compound for vanity purposes, and others report modest fat loss and weight gain after multi-week courses.[2][3]

Enobosarm is not approved for medical use. It has been studied for muscle wasting in cancer, stress urinary incontinence and breast cancer, and the FDA has warned about SARMs sold for bodybuilding.[1]

paras: Enobosarm was identified in 2004 and has been in clinical development since about 2005; GTx developed it and Veru now leads development.[1]

In a phase 2 trial in healthy older men and postmenopausal women, lean body mass rose in a dose-related way, about 1.3 kg over placebo at 3 mg/day.[1] Two phase 3 lung cancer trials reported in 2013 found lean mass gains of roughly 0.4 to 0.5 kg without strength improvements; a 2018 phase 2 incontinence trial missed its primary goal.[1] Enobosarm has also been tested with pembrolizumab in metastatic breast cancer.[4] These studies do not test mini-cycles in healthy lifters.

Reported effects include headache, fatigue, anemia and nausea. In healthy elderly men total testosterone fell 31% at 1 mg/day and 57% at 3 mg/day, HDL cholesterol fell 17% and 27%, and liver enzyme elevations occurred in some participants.[1] One T Nation poster described major testosterone suppression after three weeks.[5]

The WADA banned SARMs in 2008 and athletes across sports have been sanctioned.[1] Many online products labeled as enobosarm contain none or other substances, and non-medical users often use amounts several times those studied; their safety is unknown.[1]

lore.intro: Ostarine is discussed on T Nation as a mild aesthetics-focused option and as a cause of unexpected side effects.[2][5]
